name: Hanzo OSS Developer Payout Program
notes: Up to 25% of all Hanzo cloud spend is attributed to the upstream OSS dependencies present in the SBOM(s) of what each org runs, split pro-rata by weight. poolFraction is hard-capped at 0.25 in code (ossattr.MaxPoolFraction); raising it here above 0.25 has no effect. Direct dependencies are weighted 4x a transitive dependency by default.
